dragHandle.title: Drag area
editor.activeStepKeyInParams: Session parameter for the current step (The panel reads the step number from the session)
editor.autoplayOff: Pause between slides, ms (0 keeps the current slide)
editor.chartStyle: How to draw (A line, or a line with a fill)
editor.chartTypeRangeHint: A band between the minimum and maximum in each interval. Easier to read from one hour upward.
editor.chartTypeCandlestickHint: Open, high, low, and close for the interval.
editor.chartTypeBubbleHint: A point on a plane: one variable across, another up. A third variable can set the point size.
editor.chartTypeRadarHint: Each axis shows the latest value of its own variable. At least three axes are required.
editor.section.analyticsQueryTags: Several series (Several tags on one chart)
editor.chartBubbleDefaultSize: Point size (Used when no size variable is set)
editor.chartBubblePointsJson: Several points (Each point has its own pair of variables)
editor.chartRadarAxesJson: Axes (Label, variable, and maximum of each axis)
editor.contextParamsJsonReport: Parameters from the session (Report parameter name and session parameter name)
editor.contextPathKey: Path from the session (Name of the session parameter that holds the object path)
editor.editableAllowWrite: Allow writing (The operator can change the value)
editor.historyBucket: History step (How far to compress points: a minute, an hour, or a day)
editor.historyBucketHint: How finely history is compressed. Automatic follows the selected period: shorter for a live chart, longer for a day or a week.
editor.sampleMode: How to take points (Average over the interval, last value, or every tick)
editor.sampleModeHint: An average suits stored telemetry. The latest value thins a live stream when there is no history.
editor.liveCoalesceMs: Latest-value window, ms (How often to keep a point when using the latest value rather than an average)
editor.liveCoalesceMsHint: Usually one second, that is 1000 ms.
editor.analyticsTemplate: Saved series set (Fills the chart from a stored analytics template)
editor.analyticsQueryTagLabel: Series label (Name of the line on the chart)
editor.analyticsQueryTagsEmpty: No series yet. Add a row or paste a list below.
editor.analyticsQueryTagsHint: Several tags are drawn on one chart. The object and variable above are then unused.
editor.analyticsQueryTagsJson: Tags as text (Use this when editing the list above is less convenient)
editor.inputJsonStatic: Input values (Function input and value. ${param:name} is filled from the session when the button is pressed)
editor.maxPoints: How many points to keep (Older points beyond this are dropped)
editor.maxValueNoVariable: Maximum as a number (Used when the maximum variable is empty)
editor.minValueNoVariable: Minimum as a number (Used when the minimum variable is empty)
editor.modelHintPath: Hint for lists (Which object's variable names to show until the working object is chosen)
editor.objectPath: Object (Tree node to read data from)
editor.paramKey: Session parameter name (Where the label text comes from)
editor.parametersJsonStatic: Fixed parameters (Report parameter name and value)
editor.parentPath: Folder (Which objects the list is built from)
editor.pathKeyInParams: Parameter that holds the path (The screen chain reads the path from here)
editor.placeholder.contextPathEmpty: Used when the object above is empty and nothing has been selected yet
editor.placeholder.orEnterPath: A path can be typed by hand
editor.placeholder.orEnterVariable: A name can be typed by hand
editor.mediaEmbeddedHint: The file is stored inside the panel. A separate link is not needed.
editor.placeholder.selectionPath: A slot name, for example device. Path from panel selection; empty slot uses Object above
editor.placeholder.vectorStyle: Optional address of a map style
editor.reportHint: A table for the selected report. CSV downloads at once. PDF and Excel appear after a template is loaded for the report.
editor.rowTargetDashboard: Which panel to open on click
editor.section.drawerComposite: Slide-out panel (Side panel over the screen)
editor.functionNamesNeedObject: Choose an object first — the list is that object's functions.
editor.functionNamesEmpty: The selected object has no functions.
editor.functionInputsNeedFunction: Choose an object and a function first — the list is that function's inputs.
editor.functionInputsEmpty: The selected function has no input fields.
editor.reportParamsNeedReport: Choose a report first — the list is that report's parameters.
editor.reportParamsEmpty: The selected report has no parameters.
editor.reportColumnsNeedReport: Choose a report first — the list is that report's columns.
editor.reportColumnsEmpty: The selected report has no columns.
editor.recordFieldsNeedVariable: Choose an object and a variable first — the list is that variable's record fields.
editor.recordFieldsEmpty: The selected variable has no record fields yet.
editor.variableNamesEmpty: The selected object has no variables.
editor.objectTableVariablesNeedParent: Choose a parent folder first — the list is the variables of objects under it.
editor.objectTableVariablesEmpty: Objects under this folder have no variables.
editor.field.validateFunctionName: Step check (Runs on Next and before submit. An error code other than OK stops the step)
editor.field.confirmMessage: Ask before running (The operator must confirm, or the function is not called)
editor.field.workflowPath: Workflow instead of a function (When set, input values are not sent)
editor.field.wizardSteps: Wizard steps (Label and id of each step)
editor.field.showTruncatedWarning: Truncation warning (Shown when the report did not return every row)
editor.hint.recordVariableField: Field name inside the selected variable's record.
editor.field.nodesVariable: Nodes (Variable that holds the graph nodes)
editor.field.edgesVariable: Edges (Variable that holds the graph edges)
editor.field.currentVariable: Current (Two variables of the same object)
editor.field.maxVariable: Maximum (Two variables of the same object)
editor.field.minVariable: Minimum (If empty, the numbers below are used)
editor.field.rangeMax: Maximum (If empty, the numbers below are used)
editor.field.statusColumns: Status columns (These report columns are drawn as a dot, not as text)
editor.field.graphLayout: Layout (Free layout: nodes spread across the canvas)
editor.ganttInteractive: The scale can be moved (Pan and zoom in operator mode)
editor.ganttAllowBarDrag: Bars can be dragged (Only when the variable allows writing)
editor.section.label: Text label
editor.section.sessionContext: What is selected on the panel
editor.section.sessionContextHint: Shows the selected objects and parameters of the open panel. There are no extra fields.
editor.spreadsheet.valuesVariable: Where to save cells (A variable of the selected object)
editor.spreadsheet.dataSourceHint: Where cells are saved is set below in the table block, not by the Variable field here.
editor.spreadsheet.bindingHistoryHint: For a history cell, set how many minutes of the latest point to use. Without that, the cell shows the live value.
editor.spreadsheet.liveRefresh: Keep updating while the panel is open (Values are pulled in on their own)
editor.structured.jsonAdvanced: The same list can be edited as text.
editor.structured.miniTecHint: The diagram takes values from the object variables. No extra fields are required.
editor.scadaMimic.mimicPath: Diagram (Optional. Without it the diagram stays in the widget)
editor.scadaMimic.inlineHint: Until a diagram is selected, bindings stay in the widget itself.
editor.scadaMimic.mimicPathHint: The diagram and bindings are read from the selected mimic and saved on the server.
scadaMimic.error.bindingRequired: Object path and variable are required for this action.
view.scadaMimic.missingMimicHint: Create it under Explorer → Mimics (or re-apply the scada-facility-overview template so the platform creates an empty canvas), then draw symbols in the Mimic editor.
view.scadaMimic.emptyCanvasHint: Empty mimic — open the Mimic editor for this path and add pump/valve symbols.
editor.structured.nestedWidgetsHint: Widgets inside this panel are set in the list below or dragged onto the grid.
editor.structured.stylesJsonAdvanced: All styles as text (When the field you need is not in the list above)
editor.structured.tabs: Tabs (Name and label of each one)
spreadsheet.importNameHint: Check function names or replace unsupported formulas before relying on calculated values.
spreadsheet.importXlsxError: Could not read the Excel file
spreadsheet.variablePersistDenied: No write access to variable "{{name}}" on {{objectPath}} (ACL). Sign in with WRITE permission or change objectPath.
spreadsheet.persistForbidden: Server rejected the save (403). Refresh the page (Ctrl+F5); contact support if it persists.
spreadsheet.sessionExpired: Session expired or token invalid. Log out and sign in again to save to the object variable.

editor.section.svgInteractive: Interactive drawing (Areas on the SVG are tied to objects)
editor.selectionKeyFromSession: Selection slot (Object path from a row on this panel)
editor.rowSelectionSlot: Path slot on the opened screen
editor.rowTargetSelectionKey: Path slot on the target screen
editor.paramBindings: Fill form fields from the session
editor.syncFieldsToSession: Write form fields into the session
editor.contextSelection: Selected objects on the opened screen
editor.statusHint: Reads a variable of the object. When no name is set, status is used.
editor.targetDashboardPathKeyFromParams: Parameter that holds the panel (Which panel to open is taken from the session)
editor.textJsonAlt: Text by language (When each language needs its own label)
editor.textStatic: Text (When it should not come from the session)
editor.unit: Unit (Text next to the value, for example °C)
editor.unitField: Where to take the unit (A field of the same record, when the unit sits next to the value)
editor.variableName: Variable (Name of the selected object's variable)
editor.variablesJsonAll: Which variables to show (Empty shows every variable of the object)
editor.yesWithYarg: Yes, when a template is loaded
history.label: History
miniTec.islandMode: ISLAND MODE — powered by own generation
type.label: Label
view.workflowWaiting: Workflow waiting for operator — see Overview
view.requireSessionParams: Select a row in the table above
view.chartBubble.waitingData: Configure bubble bindings or wait for live values
view.chartRadar.configureAxes: Add radarAxesJson in widget settings (≥3 axes)
view.ganttHintInteractive: Scroll to zoom · drag timeline to pan · double-click to reset
view.ganttHintInteractiveDrag: Scroll to zoom · drag timeline to pan · drag bars to reschedule · double-click to reset
view.selectObjectInTable: Select an object in the table
editor.bindingHint.objectVariable: The value is read from a variable of the selected object.
editor.bindingHint.objectOnly: An object is required. Variables, when the widget has them, are set in its own fields.
editor.bindingHint.parentCatalog: The list is built from objects inside the selected folder.
editor.bindingHint.session: The text or path comes from parameters of the open panel.
editor.bindingHint.static: The content is stored in the widget and is not read from a variable.
editor.bindingHint.external: The widget opens a report, panel, queue, or event list. The path is set below.
editor.bindingHint.composition: A composite widget: nested panels and menu items are set in the fields below.
editor.typeHint.value: Shows one field of the variable, usually value.
editor.typeHint.toggle: The button writes a new value into an object variable.
editor.typeHint.indicator: Color and label follow the variable state.
editor.typeHint.chart: A history chart of the variable. Period and sampling are set below.
editor.typeHint.sparkline: A short trend line without axes.
editor.typeHint.gauge: A needle between the minimum and the maximum.
editor.typeHint.progress: A bar: the current value against the maximum.
editor.typeHint.statusBadge: A short state label. When no variable is set, status is used.
editor.typeHint.map: A map point for each object in the folder. Coordinates come from latitude and longitude variables.
editor.typeHint.objectTable: A table of objects inside the folder. Columns are set below.
editor.typeHint.eventFeed: The latest events. A folder and event names can limit the list.
editor.typeHint.spreadsheet: A spreadsheet. Cells are kept in the panel session or in an object variable.
editor.typeHint.timer: A countdown, or the time since a moment stored in a variable.
editor.typeHint.function: Button runs a function or workflow on an object. Set Object above, or tie to a table row via the selection slot.
editor.typeHint.functionForm: Form runs a function on an object. Set Object above, or tie to a table row via the selection slot.
view.multiPenTrend.title: Trend

view.svgInteractive.needConfig: Set behaviorsJson and bindingsJson (same as a SCADA symbol).
editor.spreadsheet.sessionKeyHint: The grid is stored under this name while the panel is open. Example: {{example}}
editor.spreadsheet.frozenRows: Freeze rows (How many top rows stay put while scrolling)
editor.spreadsheet.frozenCols: Freeze columns (How many left columns stay put while scrolling)
editor.structured.stepId: Step name (The panel finds the step by this name)
editor.structured.tabId: Tab name (The panel finds the tab by this name)
editor.structured.alarmMode: Flash on alarm (The widget draws attention when the state is an alarm)
editor.field.namePattern: Name filter (A pattern such as gpu-*. The star matches any part of the name)
editor.field.objectType: Object type (Which objects from the folder to show)
editor.field.operatorAppId: Operator application (When the queue is shared by several applications)
editor.field.emptyMessage: Text when there are no rows
editor.field.showHtml: Show the report on the page (A table under the download buttons)
editor.field.selectable: A row can be selected (A click remembers the object)
editor.field.openMode: How to open (Go to the panel, or show it on top)
editor.field.modalTitle: Window title (Only when the panel opens on top)
editor.field.svgUrl: Drawing (A file address, or an upload from the computer)
editor.field.showLegend: Show the legend (Labels of areas on the drawing)
editor.field.panEnabled: The drawing can be moved (Pan, and zoom with the wheel)
editor.field.inheritContext: Pass the selection and parameters (The nested panel sees the same context)
editor.field.variant: Panel look (Only the plain look is available)
editor.field.childrenJson: Nested widgets (The widgets inside this panel)
editor.field.drawerLabel: Button label (The text that opens the side panel)
editor.field.tabsJson: Tabs as text (The same list, when editing it as a whole is easier)
editor.field.slidesJson: Slides (Label and content of each slide)
editor.field.stepsJson: Steps (Label and internal name of each step)
editor.field.variablesToShow: Which variables to show (Empty uses the default variables)
editor.field.latVariable: Latitude variable (Where the object coordinates come from)
editor.field.latField: Latitude field (A field inside the coordinates variable)
editor.field.lonField: Longitude field (A field inside the coordinates variable)
editor.field.labelVariable: Point label (Optional variable with the object name)
editor.field.zoom: Zoom (1 is the whole world, 18 is a street)
editor.field.mapStyleUrl: Map style address (An optional style instead of ordinary tiles)
editor.field.tileAttribution: Map credit (Whose tiles are shown, for example OpenStreetMap)
editor.field.imageUrl: Picture (A file address, or an upload from the computer)
editor.field.alt: Text instead of the picture (Shown when the file does not load)
editor.field.html: Markup (HTML the widget shows as written)
editor.field.maxDepth: Tree depth (How many folder levels to open)
editor.hint.exampleVariable: A variable name, for example temperature
editor.hint.exampleColumnVariable: An object variable name, for example sysName
editor.hint.exampleSelection: A slot name, for example device. The selected object path is written here
editor.hint.selectionKeyFromSession: A slot name, for example device. Must match “Write path on click” on a table or map on this panel. When the slot has a path, it replaces the Object field; when empty, Object is used.
editor.hint.selectionKeyOnClick: A slot name, for example device. On click the object path is stored here; buttons and value widgets with the same slot read it.
editor.hint.exampleDashboardPath: A panel path, for example root.platform.dashboards.detail
editor.hint.exampleFolder: A folder, for example root.platform.devices. Empty means events from the whole platform
editor.hint.exampleMimic: A diagram path, for example root.platform.mimics.my-mimic
editor.hint.exampleWorkflow: A workflow path, for example root.platform.workflows.my-flow
editor.hint.exampleReport: A report path, for example root.platform.reports.ready-items
editor.hint.exampleSvg: A drawing address, for example /lab-assets/button.svg. A file can be uploaded instead.
